high_level_description: Strictly non-photographic, wordless Đông Hồ folk woodblock illustration: one village printer labors over a dense session block while three lightweight scene sheets bearing its same fresh lattice mark hang beyond a narrow receiving frame and one unmarked sheet remains outside, rendered in flat natural pigments on shimmering điệp paper.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A full field of pale điệp paper with visible shell-powder flecks supports one flat village-print composition in vermilion, yellow ochre, leaf green and dense black. A narrow black ground band anchors the figures without realistic depth. No room, sky gradient, photographic light, perspective recession, alphabet, numeral, caption, arrow, interface, diagram, coin, official seal, throne, national flag or modern computer appears.

elements.desc: Adult Đông Hồ printmaker kneeling at the center-left, medium skin tone, black hair tied beneath a plain brown headcloth, leaf-green tunic, dark trousers and bare feet. With a concentrated neutral expression, both hands rub a heavy black pad across one unusually dense carved block; no badge, weapon, crown, judging staff or command gesture appears.

Dense rectangular pearwood session block resting before the printmaker, carved with one compact interlocking lattice and surrounded by a shallow vermilion pigment dish, rubbing pad and small pile of spent test scraps. Its intricate cutting makes the initial effort physically evident; it contains no writing, number, portrait, state emblem, certification crest or religious motif.

Tall bamboo receiving and drying frame occupying the right half, built from two upright poles and four horizontal rails in a single frontal plane. Three finished sheets hang beyond its narrow lower opening, while the opening visibly matches the compact lattice patch carried by those sheets; it has no guard, lock, sign, scale, ranking shelf or directional marker.

First finished điệp-paper sheet hanging from the upper rail, printed with a flat vermilion village courtyard, one green tree and two black chickens. A compact black lattice patch occupies its lower-left corner in the same size and geometry as the dense session block; the sheet contains no letters, numerals, border legend, signature or official seal.

Second finished điệp-paper sheet hanging from the middle rail, printed with a flat yellow-ochre pond, two green fish and black reeds. The identical compact black lattice patch sits at its lower-left corner, showing reuse inside one short session while the scene itself differs; no text, numeral, caption, signature, logo or authority emblem appears.

Third finished điệp-paper sheet hanging from the lower rail, printed with a flat green market basket, vermilion fruit and two black leaves. The same compact lattice patch occupies its lower-left corner, unchanged from the first two sheets; its distinct payload has no alphabetic marks, numeral, signature, label, certification crest or directional symbol.

Single unmarked blank điệp-paper sheet lying outside the receiving frame at the lower-right edge, carrying one simple ochre bird scene but an empty lower-left corner where the dense lattice patch would sit. The sheet remains fully visible and undamaged, separated from the hanging set without rejection stamp, cross, warning icon, caption, arrow or human punishment.
